label: 10月8日
subtitle: 债券收益率摸到二十四年高位 · 股市和房贷一起被拖下水

briefs.en: American stocks slipped on Wednesday as government bond yields touched their highest level in twenty-four years before easing back.
briefs.cn: 周三美股小幅下跌,因为政府债券收益率一度摸到二十四年来最高,随后又回落。

briefs.en: Minutes from the September meeting showed most Federal Reserve officials expect one more rate increase this year, though few see a reason to move in October.
briefs.cn: 9 月会议纪要显示,多数美联储官员预计年内还会再加息一次,但几乎没人认为 10 月就该动手。

briefs.en: Samsung Electronics guided third-quarter operating profit to 107.4 trillion won, almost nine times the 12.17 trillion it earned a year earlier.
briefs.cn: 三星电子预告三季度营业利润 107.4 万亿韩元,接近去年同期 12.17 万亿的九倍。

briefs.en: SpaceX has discussed raising about $40 billion to buy Nvidia chips, and Oracle is said to be arranging similar financing with Apollo and Goldman Sachs.
briefs.cn: SpaceX 讨论过筹集约 400 亿美元购买英伟达芯片;据称甲骨文也在与阿波罗、高盛安排类似的融资。

briefs.en: The knock-on reached housing: the average thirty-year mortgage rate sat at 7.52%, and a fund tracking homebuilders fell 2.6%.
briefs.cn: 连锁反应传到了房地产:30 年固定房贷平均利率停在 7.52%,追踪住宅建筑商的基金下跌 2.6%。

deep.title: One number moves, and everything else follows
deep.titleCn: 一个数字动了,其他全跟着动

sentences.en: American government bond yields climbed on Wednesday to levels last seen two decades ago, and the shock worked its way through almost every other market.
sentences.cn: 周三美国政府债券收益率涨到了二十年未见的水平,这股冲击一层层传到了几乎所有其他市场。

sentences.en: The yield on the ten-year note touched 5.361% during the session, a twenty-four-year high, before a well-subscribed auction pulled it back.
sentences.cn: 十年期国债收益率盘中摸到 5.361%,是二十四年来的高点,随后一场认购踊跃的标售把它拉了回来。

sentences.en: Shares fell as investors did the arithmetic: when the government pays more to borrow, mortgages and corporate loans get more expensive too.
sentences.cn: 股票下跌,因为投资者算了一笔账:政府借钱的成本上去了,房贷和企业贷款也会跟着变贵。

sentences.en: The average thirty-year mortgage rate stood at 7.52%, near a three-year high, and a fund that tracks homebuilders dropped 2.6%.
sentences.cn: 三十年期固定房贷平均利率停在 7.52%,接近三年高位,一只追踪住宅建筑商的基金下跌 2.6%。

sentences.en: Smaller companies, which borrow on worse terms than large ones, fared worse still.
sentences.cn: 小公司借钱的条件本来就不如大公司,处境更差。

sentences.en: The Russell 2000 fell 1.3% and now sits about 9% below its peak, close to what traders call correction territory.
sentences.cn: 罗素 2000 指数下跌 1.3%,目前比高点低约 9%,接近交易员所说的「回调区」。

sentences.en: The dollar climbed as investors looked for somewhere safe, which in turn weighed on gold, down 1.1% to $4,113.80 an ounce.
sentences.cn: 美元走高,因为投资者在找安全的地方放钱;这反过来又压住了黄金,金价下跌 1.1% 至每盎司 4,113.80 美元。

notes: 一层层传过去。描述冲击从一个市场扩散到另一个市场,比 spread to 更有过程感。
levels last seen two decades ago
二十年未见的水平。用 last seen 代替 the highest since,同一个意思换个说法。
盘中摸到。session 指当天的交易时段;touch 表示碰到就走,没有停住。
before a well-subscribed auction pulled it back
随后被拉回来。before 在这里不是「在…之前」,而是叙述下一步发生了什么。
算一笔账。比 realize 更形象,指市场自己推演后果。
处境更糟。fare 指「境况如何」;worse still 加一层递进,比 even worse 更书面。
比高点低约 9%。用 sit 表示现在停在哪个位置,是个静态的说法。
which in turn weighed on gold
这反过来又压住了黄金。in turn 专门用来接因果链条的下一环。

vocab.ex: The yield on the ten-year note rose to 5.276%.
vocab.exCn: 十年期国债的收益率升到 5.276%。
vocab.tip: 债券价格和收益率反着走:价格跌,收益率就涨。动词的 yield 是「产出、让步」,名词在金融里固定指收益率。

vocab.ex: Investors sold Treasurys and bought the dollar.
vocab.exCn: 投资者卖出美国国债,买入美元。
vocab.tip: 大写专指美国财政部发的债。注意拼写里是 -easu-,很多人会漏掉 a。复数在美国媒体写 Treasurys,不是 Treasuries。

vocab.ex: Yields eased after a well-subscribed auction.
vocab.exCn: 一场认购踊跃的标售之后,收益率回落。
vocab.tip: 政府卖新债的拍卖。买的人踊跃叫 well-subscribed,冷清叫 weak / poorly received。

vocab.ex: Higher borrowing costs squeeze companies with heavy debt.
vocab.exCn: 借钱成本上升会挤压负债重的公司。
vocab.tip: 永远用复数。说利率对企业的影响时,比直接说 interest rates 更自然。

vocab.ex: A stronger dollar weighed on gold prices.
vocab.tip: 今天的核心词。表示持续往下压,不是一下子砸。过去式 weighed,别写成 weighted。

vocab.ex: Volatility in yields sparked concerns about credit costs.
vocab.exCn: 收益率的剧烈波动引发了对信贷成本的担忧。
vocab.tip: 原意是火花。后面常接 concerns / fears / a rally / a selloff,强调一下子点着了。

vocab.ex: The average thirty-year mortgage rate sat at 7.52%.
vocab.exCn: 三十年期固定房贷平均利率停在 7.52%。
vocab.tip: mortgage 里的 t 不发音,读作 MOR-gij。美国房贷默认是三十年固定。

vocab.ex: The index is on the cusp of correction territory.
vocab.exCn: 该指数正处在进入回调区间的边缘。
vocab.tip: 市场约定:从高点跌超过 10% 叫 correction,跌超过 20% 叫 bear market。territory 在这里是「地界」的意思。

vocab.ex: The dollar drew safe-haven buying as stocks fell.
vocab.exCn: 股市下跌时,美元吸引了避险买盘。
vocab.tip: haven 是港湾,不是 heaven。做定语时加连字符:safe-haven demand。

vocab.ex: The dollar rose, which in turn weighed on gold.
vocab.exCn: 美元上涨,这反过来又压住了黄金。
vocab.tip: 专门用来接因果链的下一环。放在主语和动词之间,前面常配 which。

vocab.ex: The yield touched 5.361% during the session.
vocab.exCn: 该收益率在当天交易中摸到 5.361%。
vocab.tip: 一个交易日叫 a session。连涨四天是 for a fourth straight session。

vocab.ex: Yields eased in the wake of the auction.
vocab.exCn: 标售之后收益率有所回落。
vocab.tip: 幅度小、语气轻,带点「松一口气」的意味。说央行放松政策也用它:ease policy。

patterns.title: 谁拖累了谁,谁又推高了谁
patterns.intro: 今天整条新闻就是一串因果。中文一个「影响」能糊过去,英文必须挑出方向和力度。
rows: A stronger dollar weighed on gold prices.
Weak overseas demand dragged on third-quarter profit.
Rising rates are eroding the value of fast-growing tech stocks.
The investigation dented confidence in farm-equipment makers.
A well-subscribed auction lifted bond prices.
AI demand fueled a ninefold jump in memory profit.
A handful of tech names are propping up the index.

drill.q: 把这句译成英文:「收益率上升拖累了住宅建筑商的股票。」
drill.a: Rising yields weighed on homebuilder shares.
drill.hint: 持续的压力,不是一次性打击,所以用 weigh on。

patterns.title: 把原因塞进一句话,靠这几个小词
patterns.intro: 英文新闻很少写 because。原因通常由一个介词或连词带出来,句子就不用断开。
rows: 同时发生,带因果味,最常用
Stocks fell as Treasury yields tested multidecade highs.
The stock soared after the company announced a financing deal.
Shares rose on news of the deal.
France is issuing more short-term debt amid bond-market turmoil.
Yields eased in the wake of a strong auction.
Profit jumped on the back of surging AI demand.

drill.q: 填空:Stocks fell ____ Treasury yields tested multidecade highs.
drill.hint: 两件事同时发生,而且前者是后者造成的。

patterns.title: 说「多少年来最高」,有好几种换法
patterns.intro: 一篇稿子里同一个意思要换着说,不然读起来像复读机。这几种随便挑。
rows: The ten-year yield hit a 24-year high of 5.361%.
The thirty-year bond is near its highest level since 2002.
levels last seen two decades ago
Yields climbed to levels last seen two decades ago.
Treasury yields are testing multidecade highs.
The index is on the verge of correction territory.
The Russell 2000 sits about 9% below its peak.

drill.q: 造一句:十年期收益率盘中摸到 5.361%,为二十四年来最高。
drill.a: The ten-year yield touched 5.361% during the session, a 24-year high.
drill.hint: 主干写完,年数用逗号接在后面做补充。

quiz.q: Rising borrowing costs ____ on homebuilder shares.
quiz.why: weigh on 是持续往下压。lift 是往上抬,spark 后面要接 concerns 这类名词,ease 不能接 on。

quiz.q: Stocks fell ____ Treasury yields tested multidecade highs.
quiz.why: as 既表示同时发生,又带因果。although 和 despite 是转折,意思刚好反了。

quiz.q: Profit jumped ____ the back of surging AI demand.
quiz.why: 固定搭配 on the back of，靠着某股力量推上去。

quiz.q: The dollar climbed, which ____ turn ____ on gold.
quiz.why: in turn 接因果链的下一环;weigh on 用过去式 weighed,不是 weighted。

quiz.q: 把这句译成英文:「利率上升正在一点点侵蚀高成长科技股的估值。」
quiz.a: Rising rates are eroding the value of fast-growing tech stocks.
quiz.why: 「一点点侵蚀」正好是 erode。进行时表示这件事还在发生。也可以写 are chipping away at the value of ...
